title: cost-optimization-autotune-batching-caching-quant-uecon-tooling: defaults + quant profiles + unit-econ reports
author: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: Introduces autotune defaults for batching and prefix/KV caching, adds first-class quantization profiles for common model families, and ships unit-economics tooling (reporting and CSV export) to evaluate cost/latency tradeoffs per-customer and per-route. Motivation: reduce per-token cost while preserving latency SLOs for Hosted/Dedicated customers and give platform teams actionable defaults. Changes include: 1) new /autotune API to compute per-route defaults and suggested batching/caching parameters; 2) quant_profiles.yaml with calibrated profiles (int8, int4 variants) and compatibility matrix for supported models; 3) unit-econ service that aggregates token counts, batch sizes, KV cache hit rates and maps to cost estimates; 4) console hooks + export endpoint for reports; 5) migration script to backfill historical metrics. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked (Linear ENG-1248) - [x] unit tests for autotune logic - [x] integration smoke tests on staging - [x] console UI hooks and permissions - [x] docs updated and quickstart sample - [x] e2e perf run and baseline comparison (attached) Related: ENG-1310, SUP-889. Rollout plan: feature-flag behind "autotune-defaults"; gradual rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 2 weeks with automatic rollback on regression. Metrics to watch: p95 latency, tokens/sec, average batch size, KV cache hit rate, unit cost delta. CI notes: initial lint/build failed due to import ordering; fixed in commit 3. Merge notes: squash merge after final approval.
